en.title: Who is the subject of this appeal?
en.line1: The subject of an appeal may be you, or the person who you are submitting this tribunal form on behalf of.

cy.title: Pwy sy'n destun yr apêl hon?
cy.line1: Gall y sawl sy'n destun yr apêl fod yn chi, neu’r unigolyn rydych yn cyflwyno’r ffurflen tribiwnlys hon ar eu rhan.
